```{julia}
#| echo: false

using Colors, Measures
import Compose 
cp = Compose

cp.set_default_graphic_size(5inch, 3inch)
```

# Generating a horizontal axis


```{julia}

time_max = 5

tic = -0.02
ticks_array = [[(x,0), (x,tic)] for x in collect(range(0, stop=10, length=1+time_max))]

horizontal_axis = 
  (cp.context(), cp.line([(0,0), (10,0)]), cp.stroke("black"), cp.linewidth(1mm),
   cp.line(ticks_array), cp.stroke("black"), cp.linewidth(0.2mm)
  ) ;

function label(time)
  label_height = 0cp.cy + 0.25inch
  return cp.text(time, label_height, "$(time)", cp.hcenter)
  end ;
  
horizontal_axis_labels =
  (cp.context(units=cp.UnitBox(0, 1, time_max, -1,
                  leftpad=0.5inch, rightpad=0.5inch, bottompad=0.5inch)),
   label(0), label(1), label(2), label(3), label(4), label(5)
  ) ;
```



```{julia}

timeline_index = ["①", "②", "③", "④", "⑤", "⑥", "⑦", "⑧", "⑨", "⑩"]

function timeline(index)
  height = 0.1index
  return (cp.context(), 
                cp.text(0.1inch, height, timeline_index[index], 
                      cp.hleft, cp.vcenter),
                cp.line([(0, height), (10, height)]), cp.stroke("black")
         )
  end ;
```



```{julia}
#| label: fig-axis
#| fig-cap: "Trial image"
cp.compose(
     cp.context(units=cp.UnitBox(0, 1, 10, -1,
                  leftpad=0.5inch, rightpad=0.5inch, bottompad=0.5inch)),
    (cp.context(), cp.rectangle(), cp.fill("salmon"), cp.fillopacity(0.3)),
    timeline(1), timeline(2), timeline(3), timeline(4), timeline(5),
    timeline(6), timeline(7), timeline(8),
    horizontal_axis,
    horizontal_axis_labels
    )
```
